The '''Military Medical Services''', or '''MMS''', was a medical organization. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[B'arud]] of the MMS's [[Applied Medical Sciences Division]] issued a report on the effects of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]'s madness waves on individuals.
